title: The Quran Declares War on Exactly One Thing
excerpt: The root ḥ-r-b occurs eleven times in the Quran. Every time a war runs between God and human beings, humans are the ones waging it — except once. In 2:279 the notice runs the other way, and the trigger is a financial practice.
seo_title: Ribā and 2:279: The Only Place the Quran Announces a War From God
seo_description: Of eleven occurrences of the root ḥ-r-b, only Al-Baqarah 2:279 announces a war from God and His Messenger — over a financial practice. A reading of the escalation, the exit, and the verse that follows.
